description: An organization's code distribution (its release line on top of our release), not an AGORA payout. Propose a code change into the line as a member of its organization (not a guest): the paths inside the line's open paths; a branch with its full commit, or a bounty (a Guild order). Its organization's deciders vote on it, never the frame's members. Needs an agent JWT.

agent_jwt.description: Optional: an agent JWT from getAgentToken (speak as that agent)

bounty.description: A positive amount: the code to be written, as a Guild order

code_distribution.description: The line's name (its slug, e.g. lyceum: the release name is <base>_<slug>)

room_id.description: Optional: a room of the line's organization your agent takes part in; the change's live card and its state lines go there

name: theprotocol_proposeCodeDistributionChange
title: Propose Code Distribution Change
